title: 美国政府下令Anthropic禁止外国访问Mythos模型
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely. It definitely helps to get some definitions down to start.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。先明确一些定义很有帮助。

segments.en: Mythos, that was released in April by Anthropic. It's their latest model, but it was not released to the public because the company was too worried that it had a lot of cyber
segments.zh: Mythos是Anthropic在4月发布的最新模型，但未公开，因为公司担心其强大的网络能力可能被用于攻击。

segments.en: capabilities, and it could be used for cyber attacks. It was only released to a limited group of government and business partners to help those partners shore up their own cybersecurity
segments.zh: 它仅限部分政府和商业伙伴使用，以帮助他们加强网络安全。

segments.en: efforts. What happened last week was Anthropic actually released a version of that model with some added safeguards to the public. So that's what we call Fable 5, and that's
segments.zh: 上周，Anthropic发布了该模型的增强安全版本，即Fable 5，这引发了与政府的纠纷。

segments.en: sort of what started this whole situation between the government and Anthropic. So a few days after that public release, the government sent an Anthropic a letter that was an export
segments.zh: 公开后几天，政府向Anthropic发出出口管制指令，禁止外国公民访问Fable 5或Mythos 5。

segments.en: control directive that essentially blocked anyone who was a foreign national from even accessing that Fable 5 or that Mythos 5 model. So in effect, Anthropic was forced to immediately
segments.zh: Anthropic被迫立即禁用这些模型，尤其是考虑到其员工中有外国公民。

segments.en: disable those models, especially since they have foreign nationals who are employees.
segments.zh: 这影响了员工和客户，他们只能向美国公民提供模型，且目前缺乏验证用户所在地的标准。

segments.en: So this affects their employees. It affects their customers, all the sudden they're only able to provide these models to US citizens, and they don't even have a way currently of
segments.zh: 这影响到他们的员工和客户，突然之间他们只能向美国公民提供这些模型，而且目前甚至没有方法

segments.zh: 类似于了解你的客户标准，即确认使用模型者的所在地。
